Is there any other path? No. So EE4204 is a necessary prerequisite. But wait, CS4226 is a 'must'. If EE4204 is taken in Sem 5, CS4226 can be in Sem 6. But the student wants CS4226 as early as possible. Sem 5 is possible if EE4204 is in Sem 4? No, Sem 4 is past. So EE4204 must be in Sem 5. Then CS4226 in Sem 6. But CS4236 is in Sem 5. So Sem 5 has CS4236 and EE4204. Sem 6 has CS4226. This seems possible. Let's check CS4236 prereqs. Sem 5 is Y3S1. So CS2220 can be taken in Sem 5. If CS2220 is taken in Sem 5, CS4330 can be taken in Sem 6. So Sem 5: CS4236, CS2107, EE4204, CS2220. 16 MC. OK. Sem 6: CS4226, CS4330. 8 MC. OK. Sem 7: NOC. Sem 8: Exchange. Remaining courses: CS2102, CS4350. CS2102 prereq: (CS1231 or MA1100 or MA1100T or CS1231S) and (CS2030S or CS2030 or CS2030DE or CS2030HS or YSC2229 or CS2040 or CS2040C or CS2040S or CS2040DE or CS2040HS). Student has CS1231S and CS2030S and CS2040S. So CS2102 is eligible. CS2102 is offered Sem 1/2. Can be taken in Sem 5, 6, 7? Sem 7 is NOC. So Sem 5 or 6. But Sem 5 is full (16 MC). Sem 6 has CS4226 and CS4330 (8 MC). Can add CS2102 (4 MC) to Sem 6? 12 MC. OK. But CS2102 must be in same semester as CS4261. CS4261 prereq: (EE2012A or EE2012 or ST2131 or MA2216 or ST2334 or MA2116 or MA2116T) and (CS2040 or CS2040S or CS2040C or CS2040DE or CS2040HS) and (MA1100 or MA1100T or CS1231S or CS1231) and (MA2001 or MA1101R or MA1311 or MA1508E or MA1513 or MA1522). Student has ST2334, CS2040S, CS1231S, MA1522. So CS4261 is eligible. CS4261 is offered Sem 1. So CS4261 can be taken in Sem 5, 6, 7? Sem 7 is NOC. So Sem 5 or 6. CS4261 and CS2102 must be in same semester. If Sem 6 has CS4226, CS4330, CS2102, CS4261. 4+4+4+4=16 MC. OK. But CS4261 is offered Sem 1. Sem 6 is Y3S2. So CS4261 can be taken in Sem 6. So Sem 6: CS4226, CS4330, CS2102, CS4261. 16 MC. OK. Sem 5: CS4236, CS2107, EE4204, CS2220. 16 MC. OK. Sem 7: NOC. Sem 8: Exchange. Remaining: CS4350. CS3247 prereq: (CS2030S or CS2030 or CS2030DE or CS2030HS or CS2113 or CS2113T) and (CS2040 or YSC2229 or CS2040S or CS2040C or CS2040DE or CS2040HS). Student has CS2030S and CS2040S.
